mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which historically correlates with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST 3-month increase does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified trigger condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs MoM signals strong labor market conditions, which historically correlates with increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and consumer spending (RSAFS) is decreasing, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified trigger condition does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which, in a low unemployment environment (UNRATE < 4%), leads to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified trigger condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
